description: Highly elliptical, Molniya-like (conditioning near perigee). State after N = 1 period(s) vs the initial state.
status: Committed before any engine run on it (tolerances.md §4.1 item 1). Not yet reviewed or approved; immutable once approved, corrections create a new version (plan §6).

constants.source: WGS 84 values as written in docs/architecture/proposed-architecture.md §3 (ML-TASK-011 dataset input; VT-19 primary-source status in docs/verification/l2-references-report.md)

inputs.requestIdNote: requestId = "sha256:" + hex(SHA-256(UTF-8(canonicalRequestPayload(request)))) per contracts-v1.md §7.1, computed with @mission-lab/contracts canonicalRequestPayload and Node crypto SHA-256 (test code only). The engine-side hash (ML-TASK-017) is not implemented yet; these values can serve its differential test.

period.formula: a = 1/(2/‖r₀‖ − ‖v₀‖²/μ); T = 2 * Math.PI * Math.sqrt((a * a * a) / μ); duration_s = N * T (binary64, in this order); outputStep_s = duration_s so the samples are [0, duration_s]

model.constantsSource: WGS 84 values as written in docs/architecture/proposed-architecture.md §3 (ML-TASK-011 dataset input; VT-19 primary-source status in docs/verification/l2-references-report.md)
model.units: SI: m, m/s, s, rad, m³/s²
model.time: t_s / Δt: elapsed SI seconds from the epoch (contracts-v1.md §2)

producedBy.independence: Engine source (packages/astrodynamics) not read and engine not run (ADR-003); references import nothing from the engine.
producedBy.numberFormat: Every number is the shortest decimal that round-trips to the binary64 value (ECMA-262 Number::toString); JSON.parse restores the exact binary64. Signs of zero are not preserved (−0 written as 0).

method.closure: L1: the expected state at t_s = duration_s is the initial state.

l2aInformative.algorithm: Classical elements from the initial state (L2c raw extraction), E₀ = atan2(√(1 − e²) sin ν₀, e + cos ν₀), M₀ = E₀ − e sin E₀ ∈ [0, 2π), n = √(μ/a³), M = M₀ + nΔt, Kepler equation E − e sin E = M by bracketed Newton, perifocal state from E, rotated by Rz(Ω)Rx(i)Rz(ω). Not universal variables.
l2aInformative.stoppingCriterion: Newton correction |ΔE| ≤ 4u·max(1, |M|), or f(E) = 0, or no binary64 point left inside the bracket [M − e, M + e] (shrunk with the sign of f; steps leaving it replaced by bisection); at most 100 iterations; the iterate with the smallest computed |f| is returned.

referenceAccuracy.closure: Exact (initial state); the period-computation error is in the tolerance formula.

tolerance.record: docs/verification/tolerances.md revision 3 (approved by the owner 2026-11-13) §7 VT-08
tolerance.measure: Euclidean norm of (state at t_s = duration_s) − initialState
